استبعدن (form X)
# اِسْتَبْعَدْنَ (istabʕadna) /is.tab.ʕad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# اُسْتُبْعِدْنَ (ustubʕidna) /us.tub.ʕid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# اِسْتَبْعِدْنَ (istabʕidna) /is.tab.ʕid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
